serverInfo.title: MCP Endpoint Lint
serverInfo.description: Lint an MCP endpoint you name: handshake, tool schemas, JSON-RPC error conformance, pre-dial discovery, one score card. Free, no key. Built for monitors, graders and registries — the caller supplies the URL, we never lint ourselves. Call whoami first: no arguments at all, and it answers about the request you just sent. example is the other zero-argument tool — it runs a worked answer.
